thread:
sam: Quick heads-up — I'm drafting a deprecation + migration guide for the v1 SDK eateries in Optimize toolkit. Aim: clear migration steps for batching/cache/quant profiles and catch broken links before PR. Who can do a quick review?
nina: I can take a look. Do you have the code snippets ready?
sam: Minimal ones done. Old -> new auth + batch API change example below. Need another snippet for KV prefetch example and one for quant profile YAML.
liam: Ping @marta for the quant profile YAML — she owns the profiles. Also add a short note about fallback policies when quantized models underperform.
marta: On it. I'll paste a concise q-profile example in a sec. For fallback: recommend a canary with 10% traffic to non-quant, metrics to watch are answer_exact_match and latency_p95.
sam: thanks. Here's the auth + batch snippet I plan to include:
```
# old v1 usage
client = Client(api_key=os.environ['OLD_KEY'])
resp = client.generate(model='redwood-opt-3b', prompt=p, batch_size=8)

# new v2 usage
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(token=os.environ['REDWOOD_TOKEN'])
resp = c.text.generate(model='redwood-opt-3b', inputs=[p1, p2], max_tokens=256)
```
nina: looks good. For the KV prefetch snippet maybe show pseudocode plus a one-liner recommending limits for short-seq workloads.
liam: Also we should add a small checklist in the doc front: 1) run local smoke eval on representative prompts 2) compare quality metrics 3) enable canary fallback 4) update infra routing rules. Keep it short.
sam: Good checklist. I'll draft that. @link-checker can you run the link audit for the Optimize toolkit pages referenced by this doc? I want the PR to be link-clean.
link-checker: link-checker: scan complete. Found 3 broken internal links: /optimize/old-quant-guide -> 404, /docs/kv-prefetch -> 404, /sdk/v1-examples -> 301 redirect. Output saved to /tmp/link-scan-3420009999.txt
marta: I have a minimal quant profile snippet:
```yaml
quant_profile:
  model: redwood-opt-3b
  dtype: q4_0
  perf_targets:
    latency_p95_ms: 120
    throughput_rps: 40
  fallback: non_quant_variant
```
liam: Nice and compact. Add a sentence: "Start conservative on perf_targets and iterate using sample prompts."
sam: Will do. Nina — can you drop the KV prefetch pseudocode? Keep it JS and Python variants.
nina: Yep, adding both. JS example one-liner to limit prefetch size: `prefetch.limit(64)` and note: "avoid prefetch on very short-seq traffic (<32 tokens)".
devrel-bot: FYI: templates/docs-snippet-checker triggered for changed files: docs/optimize/migration-v1-to-v2.md, snippets/quant-profiles.yaml. If you want automated snippet formatting run `make docs-lint`
sam: Perfect. I'll open the PR after I patch the broken links and fold snippets under snippets/optimize. Expect draft in ~2 hours.
liam: I'll volunteer to review once draft is up, especially the rollout paragraph.
marta: I'll validate quant sample against current q-profile test harness and post results.
sam: Thanks all — will ping when PR is ready. :raised_hands:
